content.title: Here's Where to Find Tax Day Food Freebies and Deals
content.text: AARP (Getty Images; 1040 courtesy of IRS) Tax Day is April 15. If you’re looking for ways to escape the Tax Day blues, check out these 18 delicious food deals from your favorite nationwide chains. Subway Subway rewards members can get a free footlong when they buy another footlong of equal or lesser value from now through April 28. Sub Club members just need to order via the Subway app or website with the promo code FLBOGO to get the deal. In addition, 1,040 random customers who partake in this promotion on April 15, specifically, will get a free footlong coupon uploaded to their rewards account as a “refund.” Find a Subway near you. 7-Eleven 7-Eleven customers can save $10.40 when they spend at least $25 on the 7NOW Delivery app. Just use the promo code WRITEOFF on April 15 to get the deal. Learn more about the 7NOW delivery app. Krispy Kreme Krispy Kreme customers who buy a dozen doughnuts can get an Original Glazed dozen for free on April 15. This deal is good for in-shop, drive-thru, pickup or delivery orders. Just use the promo code TAXBREAK for any online or in-app orders. Locate a Krispy Kreme in your neighborhood. Goldfish Starting at 4:15 p.m. ET on April 15, you can visit GoldfishParentTax.com to answer a quick survey and get two free bags of Goldfish sent to your home. This offer will be available only while supplies last. Head to the GoldfishParentTax.comwebsite to score this freebie. Kroger Shoppers at Kroger grocery stores can get a Private Selection frozen meal for half off when they buy one from April 15 through April 22. This offer comes in the form of a digital coupon that Kroger loyalty ID members can download and redeem through their Kroger account. See if there’s a Kroger near you. Checkers & Rally’s On April 14 and 15, Checkers & Rally’s customers can get the 6 oz. Big Buford burger for just $3 — no coupons or promo codes needed. Find your local Checkers and Rally’s. Church’s Texas Chicken Church’s Texas Chicken rewards members can get an eight‑piece leg & thigh order for the discounted price of $4.99 on April 15. Make sure you’re a rewards member before Tax Day to get the deal uploaded to your account. Check out the Church’s Texas Chicken locations. Round Table Pizza Round Table Pizza patrons can get 15 percent off any dine-in, carryout or delivery order with the promo code RTP978 from April 15 through April 19 — no order minimum required. Find a Round Table Pizza in your neighborhood. Qdoba Guac is always free at Qdoba when you create your own entrée. But rewards members will receive a $5 coupon for any full-size entrée uploaded to their account if they file for “Guac Relief” by April 15 at 11:59 p.m. ET. This coupon will be redeemable between April 20 and April 26. Visit www.TaxDayGuacRelief.comto start filing. Locate a Qdoba near you. Most Popular Marco’s Pizza Marco’s Pizza customers can get a large pepperoni magnifico pizza for the discounted price of $12.99 when they use the promo code TAXRELIEF for online, in-app, over-the-phone and in-store orders. Find your closest Marco’s Pizza. Shipley Do-Nuts Shipley Do-Nuts loyalty members can get six glazed donuts for $4.15 between April 10 and April 15. Just download the reward in your Shipley Do-Nuts app and scan it in stores to get the deal. See if there’s a Shipley Do-Nuts near you. BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse guests can score $10 off a dine-in or takeout order of $40 or greater on April 15. You can redeem this deal on the BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse website or app by using the promo code TAXDAY. Take a look at the BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse locations. Great American Cookies Great American Cookies rewards members can get a free chocolate chip cookie cake slice when they buy one in stores on Tax Day. This deal will be available to redeem in the Great American Cookies and Marble Slab Creamery app on April 15. Locate your nearest Great American Cookies. Dickey’s Barbecue Pit Dickey’s Barbecue Pit customers who spend at least $50 can get a $10 discount by using the promo code WRITEOFF on dickeys.com or the Dickey’s app on April 14 and 15. See if there’s a Dickey’s Barbecue Pit close to you. Penn Station East Coast Subs Online or in-store Penn Station East Coast Subs customers can get small subs for $5.99 each (limit five per order) when they use the promo code TAX26 at checkout on April 15. Check out the Penn Station East Coast Subs locations. Fazoli’s Fazoli’s rewards members get a baked spaghetti for free when they buy one on Tax Day. You can find this deal — valid for dine-in, carryout and delivery — in the Fazoli’s app on April 15. Find your local Fazoli’s. Mountain Mike’s Pizza Spend a minimum of $40 at Mountain Mike’s Pizza on April 15 to save $10. This offer will be redeemable in the Mountain Mike’s Pizza app for rewards members. Locate your closest Mountain Mike’s Pizza. Paris Baguette Paris Baguette rewards members can get a free pastry when they buy any beverage on April 15. You can find this reward in the Paris Baguette app. Take a look at the Paris Baguette locations. Abigail Seaberg is a freelance journalist based in San Diego. She covers subjects as diverse as oncology research, local news, celebrity updates, and health and wellness topics.
